item.title: Reeves adviser sparks backlash after saying UK doesn’t ‘need any more restaurants’
item.description: Rachel Reeves’ entrepreneurship adviser Alex Depledge has faced criticism after saying Britain does not need more restaurants, angering hospitality leaders. Read more: Reeves adviser sparks backlash after saying UK doesn’t ‘need any more restaurants’

item.title: Remote EMDR Therapy: A Modern Approach to Mental Health with Psylaris
item.description: In recent years, mental health care has undergone a significant transformation. Advances in technology, combined with changing lifestyles and increased awareness of psychological wellbeing, have made online therapy not only acceptable but often preferable. Read more: Remote EMDR Therapy: A Modern Approach to Mental Health with Psylaris

item.title: British Business Bank and Haatch commit £32m to back diverse UK angel syndicates
item.description: The British Business Bank and Haatch will invest £32m into emerging angel syndicates to support early-stage UK startups across health, AI and sustainability. Read more: British Business Bank and Haatch commit £32m to back diverse UK angel syndicates

item.title: Taskforce aims to unlock £1bn in small business lending
item.description: A new government-backed taskforce is seeking to unlock £1bn in additional lending for small businesses through community development finance institutions. Read more: Taskforce aims to unlock £1bn in small business lending

item.title: Reform vows to scrap Renters’ Rights Act, warning of ‘job-killing’ regulation
item.description: Reform UK has pledged to abolish the Renters’ Rights Act if elected, prompting warnings from property experts that scrapping the law could increase instability without lowering rents. Read more: Reform vows to scrap Renters’ Rights Act, warning of ‘job-killing’ regulation

item.title: HSBC staff share $3.9bn bonus pot as profits top forecasts
item.description: HSBC has lifted its bonus pool to $3.9bn after posting stronger-than-expected profits, as CEO Georges Elhedery pushes a “high performance culture”. Read more: HSBC staff share $3.9bn bonus pot as profits top forecasts

item.title: Dwelly secures £69m to accelerate AI-led rental marketplace expansion
item.description: UK proptech Dwelly has raised £69m to acquire and digitise letting agencies nationwide, using AI to streamline rentals, maintenance and rent collection. Read more: Dwelly secures £69m to accelerate AI-led rental marketplace expansion

item.title: Aston Martin to cut 20% of workforce as annual losses widen
item.description: Aston Martin will cut around 600 jobs after net losses surged 52% to £493m, as tariffs and weak China demand hit the luxury carmaker. Read more: Aston Martin to cut 20% of workforce as annual losses widen

item.title: Heston Blumenthal’s restaurant empire under threat after HMRC winding-up petition
item.description: Heston Blumenthal’s parent company SL6 Ltd faces a winding-up petition from HMRC after posting £2m losses, putting 130 jobs at risk. Read more: Heston Blumenthal’s restaurant empire under threat after HMRC winding-up petition

item.title: John Lewis pulls plug on build-to-rent venture amid retail reset
item.description: John Lewis Partnership has scrapped its build-to-rent housing plans, citing inflation and higher interest rates as it refocuses on core retail operations. Read more: John Lewis pulls plug on build-to-rent venture amid retail reset
